title: D2P Event
description: Envelope of a domain or job event (documentType 'd2p:event'). Events are delivery and projection data, never write commands (design decision ADR-019). Consumers deduplicate by 'eventId'. Order is guaranteed per 'aggregateId' stream only; a gap in 'sequence' requires a resync from a query or snapshot. For 'd2p:artifact.revision-committed' the schema requires 'revisionId' and the registered payload shape; other 1.0 event types have open payloads until a minor release registers them.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

eventId.description: Unique ID of this event. Consumers deduplicate by it.

aggregateId.description: ID of the stream the event belongs to: an artifact ID or a job ID. Informative, not resolved by the referential level.

revisionId.description: Revision the event is about. Required for 'd2p:artifact.revision-committed', where it equals 'payload.artifactRef.revisionId'.

sequence.description: Position in the 'aggregateId' stream: starts at 1 and increases strictly by 1 without gaps per stream. There is no global order across streams.

occurredAt.description: UTC time at which the event occurred.

payload.description: Event data. For 'd2p:artifact.revision-committed' it is a 'revisionCommittedPayload' (closed); for other event types it is an open object until a minor release registers its schema.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID linking the event to the command or request that caused it.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-c14n-v1 over the whole document, excluding 'contentDigest' itself).

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

eventType.title: Event type
eventType.description: Extensible event-type vocabulary: the listed 'd2p:' terms or an extension name. An unknown 'd2p:' term is a structural error.

anyOf.description: Event types defined by this standard.

revisionCommittedPayload.title: Revision committed payload
revisionCommittedPayload.description: Registered payload of 'd2p:artifact.revision-committed': the newly committed, pinned artifact revision and its parents.

artifactRef.description: The committed artifact revision. Its 'artifactId' equals the envelope's 'aggregateId' and its 'revisionId' the envelope's 'revisionId'.

parentRevisionIds.description: Parent revisions of the committed revision, as in its revision record: empty for the first revision, one parent normally, two reserved for merges.

commandId.description: Command that produced the revision. Absent when the revision was not produced by a command.
